title: Autodesk DXF dictionary-name contract and ACIS peer-loss cross-check

head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Resolve whether DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle names are DXF dictionary keys or object fields.
Compare public DXF/API evidence with the existing generated PAR-138 profile and independent LibreDWG DXF observation.
Refresh open-source peer evidence for silent R2013+ AcDs SAB payload loss and compound INSERT sequence validity.
Refine existing implementation gates without creating duplicate findings or promoting support claims.

method.kind: Read-only official Autodesk and GitHub primary-source review plus local plan audit
localEvidenceReused: Existing generated ASCII/Binary PAR-138 profile retains style display names as dictionary keys but delivers empty DRW_TableEntry::name to typed callbacks.
Prior research observed LibreDWG-produced DXF with the NOD -> ACAD_*VIEWSTYLE child dictionary -> named style entry -> owned style object hierarchy.
Existing PAR-49/7G.3 compound block/INSERT sequence test plan already covers generated ATTRIB and SEQEND closure.
method.limitations: Autodesk references establish DXF dictionary representation and API collection identity, but not DWG-origin style-name decoding, typed serialization, or native rendering. LibreDWG issue #1411 is a reporter's result against the pinned 0.14.8593 build and is not a reproduction against current master or libdxfrw. NEWS evidence is project-authored historical scope. No peer binary or native application was executed in this pass.

par138NameRepresentation.normativeDxfRule: A DICTIONARY repeats group-3 entry-name and group-350 child-handle pairs; the OBJECTS example identifies the first dictionary as the named-object root.
par138NameRepresentation.apiIdentity: AutoCAD API methods locate DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle collections under ACAD_DETAILVIEWSTYLE and ACAD_SECTIONVIEWSTYLE in the named-object dictionary; both object classes expose Name.
par138NameRepresentation.dictionaryNameRules: AutoCAD documents dictionary keys as unique and case-insensitive, with potentially arbitrary length; the key is independent of the referenced object. The implementation only needs ASCII-insensitive matching for the two fixed root keys and handle-based child association, preserving original child-key spelling.
par138NameRepresentation.conclusion: The DXF typed name is derived from the unique child-dictionary entry key. It is not an assumed group-2 field in the style object.
par138NameRepresentation.localGap: The generated local style graph retains dictionary keys while typed callbacks receive empty DRW_TableEntry::name.
par138NameRepresentation.implementationReadiness: Representation research is resolved. Implement bounded order-independent root-key/child-dictionary/entry/object handle and owner joining; malformed or ambiguous graphs leave the typed name unset while raw evidence remains available.
